summary: Neostellar Capital Corp. filed an 8-K on July 8, 2026, reporting preliminary Q2 2026 results and an investment portfolio update. The filing discloses estimated net asset value per share between $13.25 and $13.75, down from $14.24 at March 31, 2026, reflecting periodic performance. It details new investments totaling ~$24.7 million in Huntress Labs, ClickHouse, and an SPV, along with exits. No merger, acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, or strategic review is announced; it is purely a routine operational update with financial results. An analyst would note the NAV estimate midrange $13.50, with no event-driven catalyst.
